findings.title: Structural drift: ownership
findings.body:
Standard: apps/content-api/CLAUDE.md#软删除铁律 — 软删模型的读用 findFirst 不用 findUnique
Note: Reads of model tables use findUnique (also tx.modelEntity.findUnique and tx.modelInfo.findUnique at lines 94-95). Per 数据建模规范 every model carries deletedAt, and the soft-delete rule requires findFirst instead of findUnique for soft-deletable models; on the raw transaction client no `deletedAt: null` filter is injected, so a soft-deleted row could be resolved as the revision target.
findings.recommendation: Align placement / naming / ownership with apps/content-api/CLAUDE.md#软删除铁律 — 软删模型的读用 findFirst 不用 findUnique.

Standard: apps/content-api/CLAUDE.md#软删除铁律 — 读操作严格只见存活行（deletedAt: null）
Note: The `where` filter `{ locale: draft.locale, deletedAt: null }` is spread into the blog/faq/changelog branches but dropped for the family/model branches; on the raw tx client (no db() soft-delete extension) soft-deleted model_family_info / model_info rows can be selected as revision targets, inconsistent with the deletedAt handling in the sibling branches of the same function.
findings.recommendation: Align placement / naming / ownership with apps/content-api/CLAUDE.md#软删除铁律 — 读操作严格只见存活行（deletedAt: null）.

findings.body:
Standard: apps/content-api/CLAUDE.md#文件组织 — src/modules/<域>/service.ts 业务逻辑按业务域归属
Note: Blog/faq/changelog editorial writes (null coercion to []/Prisma.DbNull, media-ref normalization and binding reconciliation, direct tx.blogI18n/faqI18n/changelogI18n.update) are implemented inside the review module, while the model branch routes through the owning domain service (ModelContentService.transcribeInfoDraft); domain write logic for blog/faq/changelog content belongs to the owning module's service per the file-organization standard.
findings.recommendation: Align placement / naming / ownership with apps/content-api/CLAUDE.md#文件组织 — src/modules/<域>/service.ts 业务逻辑按业务域归属.
